children.game_version: A martial reaction game where children mime bow, spear, and sword actions on command using light foam or short light sticks.

avoid: Heavy twisting or pole manipulation that risks loss of balance
seniors.counts: 4-count arms for bow drawing, 4-count arms for spear throwing.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the martial upper-body mime gestures—drawing a bow, throwing a spear, and waving a sword—from a seated position without acrobatic bamboo maneuvers.
seniors.standing_version: Execute gentle upper-body martial gestures while standing, omitting jump acrobatics and pole balancing.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Perform at a moderate tempo with reduced arm extension range.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestures mimicking drawing a bow, throwing a spear, and wielding a sword.
movement_profile.footwork: Vigorous martial footwork accentuating the brass anklet worn on the right ankle.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Acrobatic maneuvers using a long bamboo pole.

signature_moves.description: Physical enactment of drawing a archery bow.
signature_moves.name: Bow Drawing

signature_moves.description: Physical mime of projecting a spear.
signature_moves.name: Spear Throwing

signature_moves.description: Physical movement simulating waving or slashing a sword.
signature_moves.name: Sword Waving

music_profile.sound_description: A high-energy percussive soundscape created by the beating of dhol drums and the clashing of kanshi brass cymbals, rhythmically punctuated by the metallic jingle of a single brass anklet on the dancer's right foot.

basic_steps: Enact drawing a bow while maintaining a broad martial stance.
Mime throwing a spear with explosive forward projection.
Wave a sword in sweeping directional cuts.
Perform acrobatic maneuvers using the long bamboo pole (raibansh).
teaching.formation: Group of male dancers executing acrobatic and martial routines.
teaching.level_notes: Requires significant physical strength, flexibility, and coordination with long bamboo props.
teaching.rhythm: Accompanied by rhythmic percussion from dhol drums and kanshi cymbals.
